steps.title: Binding Energy
steps.body: Energy required to disassemble a nucleus into its constituent protons and neutrons (E = Δm c²).

steps.title: Decay Law
steps.body: Activity A = λN; N(t) = N₀ e^{-λt}; half-life t_{1/2} = ln 2 / λ.
